Digital media store |accessableby=Web, Mobile, PC, Smart TV, Chromecast, Consoles etc[https://viaplay.se/devices ''Viaplay is where you are'' - Viaplay] (Swedish) (retrieved May 11, 2020) |externallink=[https://viaplay.com/ viaplay.com] }} '''Viaplay''' is a subscription {{wp|video on demand}} service and digital media store owned and operated by {{wp|Nordic Entertainment Group}}. Launched in May 2007 as Viasat OnDemand, the service was renamed as Viaplay in March 2011, and is available in {{pmin|Sweden}}, {{pmin|Norway}}, {{pmin|Denmark}}, {{pmin|Finland}} and {{pmin|Iceland}}.[https://www.nentgroup.com/brands/viaplay ''Viaplay'' - Nordic Entertainment Group] (retrieved May 11, 2020) Content is accessible by different methods; some is available through a monthly subscription, and others can be purchased or rented. ==Availability of the animated series== As of May 2020, the following is available with a Viaplay subscription in Sweden[https://viaplay.se/barn/pokemon ''Pokémon'' -
